members.name: routing_0
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. What is the customer's issue? Pick the most specific matching issue.

criteria.card_compromised: Customer thinks their card details were stolen or compromised, or someone else is using their card/account; wants to freeze for fraud
criteria.card_lost_or_stolen: Customer's card was lost or stolen, or they want to report it lost/stolen
criteria.phone_lost_or_stolen: Customer lost their phone or it was stolen, worried about access to the app
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge on the statement that the customer does not recognise and did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal shows in the app that the customer did not make or never received
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: An unknown or unauthorised direct debit appeared on the account
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Customer forgot or cannot use their app passcode / cannot log in to the app
criteria.pin_blocked: Card PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; wants it unblocked
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund, or to cancel an order or purchase they made, or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared in the account yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: At the ATM the customer did not get the cash they asked for: it dispensed less, the wrong amount, or no money
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment the customer made was later cancelled or reversed (e.g. the app cancelled it), or money came back unexpectedly
criteria.dispute_transaction: Customer wants to dispute a transaction or merchant charge
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: Card ordered hasn't arrived yet / tracking a card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options or delivery to a country/date
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring; how to get a replacement
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app; a found card reactivated in the app
criteria.card_not_working: The customer's concern is the card itself: it is not working, keeps being rejected or declined everywhere, or they ask what is wrong with the card or whether it is in good standing
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept/swallowed the customer's card
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change the card PIN, or getting the PIN
criteria.declined_card_payment: The customer's concern is a particular purchase or transaction that was declined or denied; they ask why that transaction did not go through
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The card or cash withdrawal was declined/refused at an ATM
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or using a virtual card, or a virtual card not working
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards: how to get them, limits, rejected
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, a new card or a spare/additional card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which cards or card brands (Visa, Mastercard, others) are supported or can be chosen and used with the service
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs or merchants accept it
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up or currencies through Apple Pay / Google Pay
criteria.transfer_pending_or_timing: A transfer is pending, or how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_not_received: Recipient hasn't received a transfer the customer sent
criteria.transfer_failed_or_declined: A transfer failed or was declined; beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel or correct a transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account)
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or receive money or a salary into the account (including in another currency), SWIFT
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending, delayed, or taking a long time to go through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal (taking out cash) still pending, or the balance not yet reflecting cash taken out at an ATM
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up the account; supported top-up methods (card, cash, cheque, bank transfer)
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was reverted, or is pending; topped up money not showing
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code or why top-up needs verifying
criteria.direct_debit_setup: Setting up direct debits or payments
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment or purchase: why was I charged a fee when I paid or bought something
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fees for ATM cash withdrawals, including how much can be withdrawn without fees
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee charged for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: Exchange rates used, or a wrong exchange rate applied to a payment or withdrawal
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.currency_support: Which currencies are supported for holding or exchanging
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or fee showing on the statement or app (e.g. an unknown £1 charge) that the customer asks about, not tied to a named purchase or service
criteria.card_fees: What a card or replacement card costs
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed, why verification is needed
criteria.identity_verification_failed: Identity verification not working / app cannot verify who the customer is
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying or explaining the source of funds: where the customer's money comes from, who is giving it to them
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change name, address or personal details
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in or serves, including whether people living outside the UK can get an account or cards
criteria.unexpected_incoming_money: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there or does not recognise
criteria.amount_limits: Daily or maximum amount limits on card spending, transfers or top-ups (not fee-free allowances)
